column1: # The rediscovery table (docs/ROADMAP.md section 10.2).
# One row per protection the project has paid for. Each row names a patch
# that REVERTS the protection and the test selector that must then fail.
# `sh tools/rediscovery/run.sh --tier N` applies each row of a tier to a
# scratch copy and requires the selected tests to fail there; a protection
# whose removal changes nothing is a comment with an if statement around it.
# `sh tools/rediscovery/check-patches.sh` (a gate phase) requires every row's
# patch to still apply to the working tree, so a refactor that moves a check
# fails the gate until the patch is redone.
# Columns, tab separated:
#   patch-file  under tools/rediscovery/patches/, applied with patch -p1 at
#               the root of the scratch copy
#   tier        the tier the selected tests belong to (section 10.1)
#   stage       '-' in Phase 0; tiers 6 and 7 name their stage here
#   test        a tasty pattern (the -p argument) selecting the tests that
#               must fail; the baseline run must select at least one
#   env         '-' or VAR=VALUE assignments the row is run with; a tier-7
#               row's seed and step count live here, not in a README
